title: Photo Cull Review
user: Households with large photo archives who need to safely decide which duplicate, burst, and unwanted media can be removed before backup costs and browsing noise grow further.
smallest_useful_product: Desktop-local PWA that indexes selected folders, groups exact hashes and visually similar burst candidates, presents side-by-side keep decisions, and exports a move-to-review-folder manifest.
constraints: Local-only thumbnails and hashes; never alter originals; make moves explicit and reversible; perceptual hashing must be explained as a suggestion, not identity proof.
